name: Beef Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes and Green Beans

components.name: Glazed Beef Meatloaf
steps: Heat oven to 185 C. Sauté onion and garlic briefly to soften, then cool so the egg in the meat mixture does not heat early.
Combine beef, egg, breadcrumbs, milk, cooked onion and seasonings. Shape into a compact loaf on a parchment-lined tray.
Stir ketchup, vinegar and honey together; brush the glaze over the loaf. Bake 55-70 minutes, applying glaze again halfway through, until centre reaches 71 C.
Rest meatloaf 10 minutes, cut into six slices, and pack one slice with potatoes and beans per meal.

components.name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: While it bakes, boil peeled potatoes until tender, drain, mash with milk, butter and salt.

components.name: Roasted Green Beans
steps: Roast trimmed green beans on another tray with measured oil for 10-15 minutes until lightly blistered, or steam if oven slots are full.
